description: Load settings: the /load_preset (preset.load) request fields the engine is initialised with, read back by preset.load_settings.

domains.title: Preset load settings
domains.write: preset.load {path, ...settings} (destructive: a STRUCTURAL change is a full reload that stops audio; a HOT change of volume / max_volume / feedback / feedback_coeff keeps the engine)
domains.key_space: field names; one set for the running engine (the last FULL load)
domains.stored_vs_effective: Every omitted setting keeps the live engine's value (listed as inherited_load_params); with no engine loaded, sample_rate, string_iterations, audio_on and start_right_away are required. 'declared' = what the preset requires (fpga_conversion.load_params / required_load_params); mismatches are non-blocking warnings (load_param_warnings). output_scale is valid only at the load settings it was calibrated at (array_size, sound_derivative_order, listen_to_modes, sr, mode_iteration, string_iteration).

fields.name: path
fields.units: preset JSON path relative to pianoid_middleware (e.g. presets/BaselinePreset1.json)
fields.range: an existing preset file (else 400 invalid_preset_request before the engine is touched)
fields.meaning: The preset file of the last FULL load (never inherited; a library switch does not change it).

fields.name: sample_rate
fields.units: request: kHz (a value < 1000 is multiplied by 1000); load_settings read-back: Hz
fields.meaning: Audio sample rate; structural (full reload); part of the output_scale calibration key.

fields.name: string_iterations
fields.meaning: Number of string wave-equation steps per audio sample; structural; the float32 bass-pitch drift at high values is documented with a fix pending merge (dev-1e95).

fields.name: cycle_iterations
fields.range: minimum 16, default 64; must match the audio buffer size

fields.name: array_size
fields.units: spatial discretisation points per string block
fields.meaning: Grid size per block; a value different from the preset's native array_size rescales the string geometry proportionally; structural.

fields.name: listen_to_modes
fields.meaning: 0 = sound channels carry string bridge displacement (strings axis), 1 = they carry mode forces (modes axis); decides which mask mutes a channel; structural.

fields.name: sound_derivative_order
fields.meaning: Output derivative order of the stem signal (1st derivative = velocity, 2nd = acceleration); structural; d1 vs d2 changes the level by ~19 dB (calibration key).

fields.name: audio_driver_type
fields.range: 0 = default (SDL3, hardware-free), 1 = ASIO, 2 = SDL (auto), 3 = SDL3, 4 = ASIO_CALLBACK
fields.meaning: Audio driver; prefer 4 when an ASIO device exists, else 2; 0 for tests / headless; structural (no driver-only reopen path).

fields.name: volume
fields.units: preset (init) volume; bare volume_center = exp((volume-100)/8), max_volume = volume_center^(127/64)
fields.meaning: The load-time LEVEL ANCHOR, NOT the slider level (same name, different thing); HOT change; not calibrated by output_scale (volume 127 = +29.31 dB).

fields.name: max_volume
fields.range: float; takes precedence over volume (bare center = max_volume^(64/127))

fields.name: audio_on
fields.meaning: UNKNOWN beyond its role: REST_API lists it only as a structural load setting, required when no engine is loaded.

fields.name: start_right_away
fields.range: 1 = start realtime playback in a background thread; 0 (or any non-1) = initialise only
fields.meaning: Whether realtime playback starts at load (values 2 and 3 were removed).

fields.name: listen_to_midi
fields.range: 0 or 1; the PIANOID_LISTEN_TO_MIDI env var ('0'/'1') overrides the request
fields.meaning: 1 = start the unified MIDI listener thread (cycle-aligned dispatch); hot-toggle later via POST /midi/start and /midi/stop.

fields.name: midi_port
fields.range: optional; omitted = the saved input port, else auto-detect (dev-392a); enumerate with GET /midi/ports
fields.meaning: MIDI input port FORCED for this load when listen_to_midi = 1 (not persisted, not inherited).

fields.name: debug_mode
fields.meaning: Debug engine variant with result extraction; structural.

fields.name: use_simulation
fields.range: 0 only (1 is rejected 400 FeatureNotSupported before the engine is destroyed)

fields.name: use_cuda
fields.meaning: UNKNOWN (appears in the documented request body without a description).
